events.factual_description: BODY&SOUL presents Kengo Nakamura Presents Voices of Hope 15 on Saturday, September 12, 2026, billed as the 15th Great East Japan Earthquake charity live. Doors open at 5:30 PM, with sets at 6:30 PM and 8:00 PM. The first set features Kaoru Mikami, Rina Ogata, Grace Mahya, Charito and Kimiko Ito; the second features Rena Toshimitsu, Remi, Lileth, Ema and Maya Hatch. Dennis Lambert on piano, Kengo Nakamura on bass and Gene Jackson on drums form the announced rhythm section. The music charge is ¥5,000 for one stage or ¥9,000 for both stages, tax included, and the venue asks for cash payment because it is a charity concert. BODY&SOUL's documentation of the preceding edition describes Voices of Hope as an annual benefit sustained to support children affected by the 2011 disaster. The club has separately announced September 26 as its grand finale in its 52nd year, placing this performance in BODY&SOUL's final operational month.

en.why_it_matters: Voices of Hope is not a generic vocal-jazz showcase. Nakamura has kept the benefit alive as a long-running musical response to the 2011 disaster, and this fifteenth edition moves ten singers through two sets over a compact Lambert-Nakamura-Jackson rhythm section. Hearing that sustained act of musical solidarity inside BODY&SOUL during the club's final month makes the room itself part of the meaning.
en.trip_verdict: If September 12 overlaps a Tokyo stay, build the evening around both sets rather than treat this as a drop-in club date. The benefit's history and BODY&SOUL's closing month make this a particularly meaningful Shibuya night, even though the project itself is annual.
en.listen_before: No single prerequisite: the point is the live relay of singers and the shared rhythm section.

es.why_it_matters: Voices of Hope no es una pasarela genérica de jazz vocal. Nakamura ha sostenido este beneficio como una respuesta musical de largo aliento al desastre de 2011, y esta decimoquinta edición hace pasar a diez cantantes por dos sets sobre el núcleo compacto de Lambert, Nakamura y Jackson. Escuchar ese acto persistente de solidaridad musical dentro de BODY&SOUL durante el último mes del club hace que la propia sala sea parte del significado.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 12 de septiembre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, armaría la noche alrededor de los dos sets en vez de tratarlo como una parada casual de club. La historia del beneficio y el último mes de BODY&SOUL vuelven esta una noche especialmente significativa en Shibuya, aunque el proyecto en sí sea anual.
es.listen_before: No hace falta una escucha única: la gracia está en el relevo de voces y en el mismo trío acompañando toda la noche.
